POST /exports/sftp/schedule.asked: Northwind needs yesterday's shipments delivered as a CSV to their SFTP server every night.
POST /exports/sftp/schedule.why: A plain cron job sent the file twice after a restart, which would have double-counted shipments in billing. It moved to the job queue with an idempotency key.
POST /exports/sftp/schedule.quote: Keep the column mapping in clients/northwind for now. We'd need a second client to know what's generic.
POST /exports/sftp/schedule.reason: needed this so Northwind's billing gets yesterday's shipments every night, without anyone exporting by hand

POST /shipments/{id}/customs-hold.asked: Northwind's operations team needs to pause shipments held at customs.
POST /shipments/{id}/customs-hold.why: It was built only for Northwind because no other client ships across borders yet.
POST /shipments/{id}/customs-hold.reason: needed this because Northwind ships across borders and ops had no way to pause a shipment held at customs

GET /audit.asked: Keep audit logs for 7 years to meet Northwind's contract.
GET /audit.why: The retention setting was global, so raising it would have kept every client's logs for 7 years at about 6x the storage cost. It became a per-client override with a 1-year default.
GET /audit.changed: Retention is set per client instead of 1 year for everyone.
GET /audit.reason: needed this because Northwind's contract requires 7 years of audit logs

POST /exports/s3/schedule.asked: Globex wants a nightly CSV of shipments delivered to their S3 bucket.
POST /exports/s3/schedule.why: It was built on the plain scheduler, without the retry protection Northwind's export ended up needing.
POST /exports/s3/schedule.reason: needed this because Globex's data team loads shipments from their S3 bucket every night

GET /portal/shipments.asked: Globex's customers keep emailing support to ask where their shipments are.
GET /portal/shipments.why: It was built as a separate customer login so customers can't reach internal screens.
GET /portal/shipments.reason: needed this because Globex's customers kept emailing support to ask where their shipments were

POST /portal/shipments/{id}/issue.asked: Customers need a way to report a shipment problem from the portal.
POST /portal/shipments/{id}/issue.why: It opens a ticket in the existing support queue, so the support process didn't change.
POST /portal/shipments/{id}/issue.reason: needed this so customers can report a problem without leaving the portal

POST /invoices/{id}/send.asked: Globex's finance team rejects any invoice with no PO number.
POST /invoices/{id}/send.why: The PO number was made mandatory in the fork, which would break other clients if merged as is.
POST /invoices/{id}/send.changed: An invoice can't be sent without a PO number.
POST /invoices/{id}/send.reason: needed this because Globex's finance team rejects any invoice without a PO number
